name: Restoring Spurhook
description: Seat a hard-tipped foreshaft in the dart's socket and tap it home so it will not slip on impact.

name: Verity Throwstick
description: Study a foe's armor for the seam, rivet or joint where a narrow point can find a way in.

name: Extendassault
description: Plant the heel hard and cast through it, so the dart leaves with the weight of the stance behind it.

name: Spurleap
description: Shuffle one pace off the line after the cast so the answer to it finds only air.

name: Iron Overarm
description: Throw at the rivets of a breastplate, where qi along the shaft pushes the point through the join.

name: Needling Weightstone
description: Aim up under the chin guard, and the narrow dart slides into the gap between helm and collar.

name: Cupassault
description: Skim a dart over a raised shield's rim so it drops behind the cover into the foe's shoulder.

name: Facetspur
description: Pour qi down the shaft into the foreshaft and drive the dart through layered plate in a single blow.

name: Interlocking Atlshaft
description: Cast a first dart to pry a seam wide, then follow with two more into the opening in swift order.

name: Vital Cupend
description: Wrap the dart in a thin skin of the qi field so it leaves the board already held in the thrower's will.

name: Invigorating Dartshaft
description: Send a short pulse down the board's groove at release, adding speed beyond what the arm can give.

name: Chimecup
description: Keep a thin thread of qi attached to the flying dart and feel what it passes through.

name: Propelthrash
description: Throw with qi riding the shaft so the dart flies perfectly level until it strikes.

name: Gust Flexshaft
description: Lean into the throw and shift weight through the feet to land balanced for a fast second.

name: Spurelixir
description: Pulse qi to seat a new dart on the spur in the time of one breath.

name: Throwlever Barrage
description: Tug the qi thread to bend the dart's path a hand's width around a raised arm or shield.

name: Spurbarrage
description: Let the thread go slack so the dart stoops steeply onto a foe who thinks himself covered.

name: Perceptive Handgrip
description: Read the lingering qi trail of a foe's cast darts to learn from where he threw.

name: Glint Leverage
description: Gather qi in the board during a held breath, then release a dart that flies far past the arm's honest range.

name: Blazepropel
description: Keep the qi thread alive across several darts, each flying faster than the last along one humming path.

name: Renewing Gripbinding
description: Bind a smooth stone weight to the board's shaft with sinew, set where the board swings best.

name: Remnant Weightstone
description: Hang the board from one finger and slide the weight until it rests level.

name: Cuptorment
description: Swing the weighted board slow and deep, so the stone adds its mass to the cast.

name: Aegis Weightstone
description: Meet a blow with the weighted end of the board, trusting its mass to halt the strike.

name: Spurthrash
description: Swing the stone-weighted board in a short overhand arc to crack a foe's forearm or helm.

name: Wrecking Whipover
description: Let the stone's inertia whip the board through its arc and fling a heavy dart at great pace.

name: Manacling Handgrip
description: Cast a heavy dart that pins a foe's shield arm against his own body and drags at his balance.

name: Equipoise Fingerhooks
description: Swing the weighted end round to bat a thrown dart from the air, then loose a cast of your own.

name: Discerning Cupend
description: Sort darts by weight and length at the belt, so each range has its proper dart by touch.

name: Waning Dartshaft
description: Read the winds near the ground and high above, and aim with both in mind.

name: Fortifying Throwstick
description: Stand tall with the spine as a drawn bow, qi running its length to store the throw.

name: Propelassault
description: Release at the arc's best angle with qi in the wrist for the final push.

name: Extendcanter
description: Close on a mark with slow steps, so the thrower arrives rested and unwinded.

name: Unshaken Handgrip
description: Tuck the elbow close after the cast to guard the ribs against a counterthrow.

name: Harrowing Throwlever
description: Cast, step ten paces and cast again, bracketing the target's range until a dart lands true.

name: Gust Whipover
description: Adjust the aim mid-throw for a gust felt on the skin of the face.

name: Exacting Flexshaft
description: Stretch a long qi thread to the mark and feel exactly how far away it stands.

name: Cuppounce
description: Fall back silently after a long cast, keeping outside the foe's counter-throw.

name: Harpooning Leverage
description: Hurl a heavy dart in a very high arc with qi loaded through the body, to land on a distant mark.

name: Downpour Whipover
description: Lob several darts in one high heave, so they fall together across a patch of ground.

name: Might Handgrip
description: Carry a loaded board in each hand, each balanced against the other so the shoulders stay level.

name: Rousing Cupend
description: Seat a dart on each board's spur within one motion, so both arms stand ready.

name: Staunch Spurhook
description: Stand with feet in mirror to a partner's, each covering the other's open side.

name: Extendthrash
description: Cast with the right board and at once with the left, so the foe cannot find a rest.

name: Bounding Throwlever
description: Step along the curve of a basin's rim without changing the throwing line.

name: Severing Overarm
description: Cast two darts from two boards on crossing paths, so a foe's dodge steps into one.

name: Hour Extend
description: Trade places with a partner mid-volley, so one casts while the other reloads and no gap opens.

name: Propelbarrage
description: Arc a dart in a long curve across water or a gully to land behind the far bank's cover.

name: Tempered Whipover
description: Send darts from either side to close on one foe together, leaving him no safe side to lean.

name: Transfixing Throwlever
description: Cast two darts to strike the same spot, the second driving the first on through the guard.

name: Verity Handgrip
description: Lift the chin and fix one hawk-sharp eye on the mark, reading it from high ground.

name: Mantled Atlshaft
description: Set the feet on a ledge or roof ridge and anchor with qi so a cast cannot pitch the thrower off.

name: Heartening Flexshaft
description: Lift both arms out like opening wings, drawing qi up the spine for the stoop.

name: Scalding Extend
description: Throw down at a steep angle from height so the dart plunges as a stooping hawk does.

name: Hoarfrost Throwlever
description: Cast from high ground so the dart gathers speed and strikes harder than its weight alone allows.

name: Soaring Overarm
description: Leap from a ledge, cast in mid-air and land in a roll with the board still loaded.

name: Mindful Gripbinding
description: Leave a faint qi wake on the first dart's path to mark where it fell and correct the next.

name: Hollowspur
description: Drop from height with the dart already in flight, driving through guard with the combined fall of both.

name: Scorching Leverage
description: Hold the board aloft as qi gathers, then loose darts that fall across a patch of ground.

name: Sustaining Dartshaft
description: Train the eyes to follow two moving marks at once, one by each side of the gaze.

name: Racing Flexshaft
description: Cross wet river stones at a steady pace, never letting the board arm dip.

name: Dartshaft Elixir
description: Load a dart with each hand in alternating order, so neither hand is ever idle.

name: Spurtorment
description: Release on two lines at once, one fast and flat, one high and curving.

name: Chime Spurhook
description: Glance at the ripples of the water to judge the wind across it.

name: Implacable Throwstick
description: Crouch below the line of a river bank and cast over its lip.

name: Furrowing Propel
description: Cast two darts on separate tracks, one low and one high, so no single guard can stop both.

name: Rumble Throwlever
description: Cast two darts from different angles to meet at one point, like two streams joining.

name: Silt Fingerhooks
description: Pivot on a ford's stone and turn the line of throw without leaving the footing.

name: Nursing Handgrip
description: Pass the board from hand to hand during a reload, so the throw can switch sides unseen.

name: Unmaking Overarm
description: Run two throws at once in a steady beat, one hand leading the other by half a count.

name: Tiered Whipover
description: Cast sequences of darts from either bank, so the foe's retreat funnels into the second line.

name: Vigorous Weightstone
description: Take a bearing on the mark across open ground and hold that line against the wind.

name: Granite Cupend
description: Stand with nothing behind and the sky open, trusting the stance's balance over any cover.

name: Gustpropel
description: Wait for a gust to peak and release as it carries, letting the wind add to the throw.

name: Vaulting Handgrip
description: Run across level ground with the board low and the dart seated, ready to cast at any moment.

name: Extendbarrage
description: Hold the bearing across several casts, correcting the aim only by the wind's change.

name: Lambasting Extend
description: Aim wide of the mark into the crosswind and let it bend the dart back onto the foe.

name: Rupturing Overarm
description: Hold at the plateau's rim while qi gathers, then cast down onto foes below on the slope.

name: Resilient Gripbinding
description: Meet a thrown dart with the wind-turned board and send it back along the line it came.

name: Anointing Spurhook
description: Speak the oath silently on the breath and let it steady the throwing arm.

name: Waning Atlshaft
description: Turn one cheek to the wind and read its strength and drift before lifting the board.

name: Unflinching Cupend
description: Stand uncovered and unflinching with qi in the stance, daring a foe's dart to find a mark.

name: Scything Throwstick
description: Cast at the mark named by oath, committing to the throw with no thought of a second.

name: Mightcup
description: Advance in short wind-light steps on open ground, never setting both feet down together.

name: Nursing Throwstick
description: Reload to the count of a short spoken oath, so the hands never hurry or lag.

name: Tempered Propel
description: Cast with qi and tailwind together, so the dart carries far beyond what the arm alone gives.

name: Skinning Extend
description: Throw into a headwind at an angle that makes the dart curve around a foe's guard.

name: Enduring Handgrip
description: Hold the stance through a barrage with qi bound to the oath, and the arm does not shake.

name: Cupthrash
description: Cast dart after dart on the wind's rhythm, each one leaving as the last arrives.

name: Ponderous Leverage
description: Loose a dart that screams with wind as it passes, forcing foes low and stopping their own casts.

name: Rejuvenating Dartshaft
description: Open and close the hands in the cold air until qi warms the fingers for a sure grip.

name: Verity Flexshaft
description: Glance at the drift of clouds to judge the wind aloft where the dart will travel.

name: Ironcup
description: Settle the feet wide and flat on bare ground, so no gust or blow can topple the thrower.

name: Cupendassault
description: Cast at shoulder height along the flat of the plain, with no arc and no flourish.

name: Whipping Throwstick
description: Back away in long, even paces on open ground while the board stays level and loaded.

name: Nova Extend
description: Cast up a slope's face where the updraft lifts the dart onto a target on the heights.

name: Lambasting Propel
description: Change the aim by small steps each cast, so the volley sweeps across a line of foes.

name: Granite Handgrip
description: Slip into the lee of a rock or rise and cast from the still air behind it.

name: Ravaging Throwlever
description: Sweep a rolling cast of darts across a broad front, so no foe on the line is spared.

name: Tempered Overarm
description: Cast in a calm moment of the wind with all qi poured in, so the dart drives through armor.
